quotes.text: 第四个好汉姓陶，名宗旺，祖贯是光州人氏。庄家田户出身，惯使一把铁锹，有的是气力，亦能使枪抡刀，因此人都唤做“九尾龟”。
宗旺力如猛虎，铁锹到处无情，
神龟九尾喻多能，都是英雄头领。

explicit_facts: Human Tao Zongwang, from Guang prefecture (光州), farming household, strong, accustomed to iron spade, also able to wield spear/saber.
The poem explicitly frames the turtle nickname as a metaphor.
art_interpretations: Exact face, age, sun-weathered skin, beard, cloth headwrap, brown work clothes follow existing game references; not literal novel costume/phenotype assertions.
Spade shape, shoulder arrangement, parchment and close-bust composition are portrait design.
